Release info wrote:

Source:
• Source: Salaam Bombay! 1988 1080p Remux AVC FLAC1.0-CiNEPHiLES (Thanks!)
Source #1: Criterion Blu-ray (video, audio, commentary, subtitles, chapters) - thanks TMT!
Source #2: BFI Blu-ray (commentary, subtitles) - thanks anonymous!

Video
Criterion is a new 4K restoration from the original negative, with improved detail and color grading, falling somewhere between BFI's colder and Kino's warmer tints.

Criterion (2025) vs BFI (2021) vs Kino Lorber (2015): https://example.invalid/link

Audio
Criterion and Kino Lorber appear to be from the same master, but Kino Lorber's first third is strangely quieter than the rest. BFI has different EQ and some noise reduction in the highest frequencies. All in all, nothing audible.

Audio comparisons: Spectrograms, Waveforms

Subtitles
Included two different translations from Criterion and BFI. Kino Lorber's was excluded as it's quite similar to Criterion.
Video:
• Criterion has better details than both BFI and Kino Lorber. All releases have different colors and Criterion claims that its new restoration was supervised and approved by director Mira Nair.
• Fixed dirtylines on top and bottom. Fixed blurred margins caused by x264 partition.
• Debanded intro and zoned.
Subtitles:
• Chinese(Simplified & Traditional & Commentary #1) were translated from English subs via Gemini 3 pro and GPT-5, checked and fixed some common errors. Retail R3 Chinese subs were poorly translated so not included.
• All other subtitles from Source, please check mediainfo for more.
Others:
• Chapters included and named from Source.
• Greetings to Miralia and all my friends@User.

import vapoursynth as vs
import awsmfunc as awf
import havsfunc as haf
import mvsfunc as mvf
from rekt import rektlvls
import kagefunc as kgf
import adptvgrnMod as agm
core = vs.core

##Source In
src = core.lsmas.LWLibavSource(r"Video.mkv")
src = core.std.Crop(src,top=22,bottom=22)
src16 = mvf.Depth(src,16)

##Dirtylines
fix = rektlvls(src16,rownum=[0,1],rowval=[-4,1])
fix = awf.bbmod(fix,bottom=2,blur=100)

top = core.std.Crop(fix,bottom=1026)
bot = core.std.Crop(fix,top=10)
gtop = agm.adptvgrnMod(top,strength=[0.55,0.35], size=1.5, sharp=190, static=False, luma_scaling=-1, seed=-1)
y = core.std.ShufflePlanes(top, 0, vs.GRAY)
mask = core.std.Binarize(y, 7000)
gtop = core.std.MaskedMerge(top, gtop, mask)
gfix = core.std.StackVertical([gtop,bot])

mappings_gf = "[1366 160340]"
gfix = core.remap.Rfs(fix,gfix, mappings=mappings_gf)

##Deband
#Intro [314 668]
deband = core.neo_f3kdb.Deband(gfix, range = 15, y = 65, cb = 60, cr = 60, grainy = 0, grainc = 0, dynamic_grain = True, output_depth = 16)
gf = agm.adptvgrnMod(deband,strength=[0.5,0], size=1.5, sharp=80, static=False, luma_scaling=5, seed=-1, show_mask=False)
mappings_db = "[314 668]"
db = core.remap.Rfs(gfix,gf, mappings=mappings_db)

y = core.std.ShufflePlanes(gfix, 0, vs.GRAY)
mask = core.std.Binarize(y, 4100)
db = core.std.MaskedMerge(gfix, db, mask)

##Output
out = mvf.Depth(db,8)
out.set_output()
